_: Overrides for the repository table. 'en' and 'pt' replace the GitHub description in each README; 'stack' replaces language + topics. Keys are repository names.

Injector.en: x64 DLL injector for Windows with LoadLibrary, Manual Map and Thread Hijack. Dear ImGui interface on DirectX 11.
Injector.pt: Injetor de DLL para Windows x64 com LoadLibrary, Manual Map e Thread Hijack. Interface em Dear ImGui sobre DirectX 11.

Kernel-Driver-Bypass.en: Windows kernel driver written in C, with parts in C++ and Assembly.
Kernel-Driver-Bypass.pt: Driver de kernel para Windows escrito em C, com partes em C++ e Assembly.

fix-wsl-docker.en: PowerShell script that fixes the WSL and Docker integration on Windows.
fix-wsl-docker.pt: Script PowerShell que conserta a integração entre WSL e Docker no Windows.

inertia.en: TCP and UDP port scanner: async Rust core, Python interface, per-target timeout calibration. Available on PyPI.
inertia.pt: Scanner de portas TCP e UDP: núcleo assíncrono em Rust, interface em Python, timeouts calibrados por alvo. Disponível no PyPI.
